lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Two weeks ago, Bobby's parents bought a robot from a shop.
lines.chinese: 两周前，Bobby的父母从商店买了一个机器人。

lines.speaker: Bobby's father
lines.english: Look at this robot! He's very smart!
lines.chinese: 看看这个机器人！他非常聪明！

lines.speaker: Bobby's mother
lines.english: He can do many things!
lines.chinese: 他会做很多事情！

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Cool!
lines.chinese: 真酷！

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: The robot cooked a big dinner. Bobby, Tina and their parents liked the food very much.
lines.chinese: 机器人做了一顿丰盛的晚餐。Bobby、Tina和父母都非常喜欢这些食物。

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: It's delicious!
lines.chinese: 真好吃！

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: What a smart robot!
lines.chinese: 多聪明的机器人啊！

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: The robot played Chinese chess with Bobby. He won every time.
lines.chinese: 机器人和Bobby下中国象棋。他每次都赢。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: How smart!
lines.chinese: 真聪明！

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: One day, Bobby, Tina and their parents went to the park. They came back late.
lines.chinese: 一天，Bobby、Tina和父母去了公园。他们回来得很晚。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: I'm hungry. What's for dinner today?
lines.chinese: 我饿了。今天晚餐吃什么？

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: Our robot is cooking dinner for us. He'll give us a surprise.
lines.chinese: 我们的机器人正在为我们做晚餐。他会给我们一个惊喜。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: I can't wait!
lines.chinese: 我等不及了！

lines.speaker: Bobby's mother
lines.english: What happened?
lines.chinese: 发生了什么？

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Where's our dinner?
lines.chinese: 我们的晚餐在哪里？

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: Where's the robot?
lines.chinese: 机器人在哪里？

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: Look! Here's our robot!
lines.chinese: 看！我们的机器人在这里！

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Oh no! What's wrong with the robot?
lines.chinese: 哦，不！机器人怎么了？

sections.title: Sounds in focus — Listen and read along

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Last week, I bought a robot online.
lines.chinese: 上周，我在网上买了一个机器人。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: It does a lot of chores.
lines.chinese: 它做很多家务。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: It never gets tired.
lines.chinese: 它从不疲倦。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: I can talk to it on the screen.
lines.chinese: 我可以通过屏幕和它说话。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: It makes my house clean.
lines.chinese: 它使我的房子保持干净。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: Hi, Grandpa and Grandma. I'm doing a project on life in the past and now. Can you tell me about the changes in your life?
lines.chinese: 爷爷奶奶，你们好。我正在做一个关于过去和现在生活的项目。你们能给我讲讲生活中的变化吗？

lines.speaker: Grandpa
lines.english: Sure. In the past, I wrote letters to my family and friends. Now I chat with them on the internet.
lines.chinese: 当然。过去，我给家人和朋友写信。现在，我在网上和他们聊天。

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.english: And we spent a lot of time on the road then. Now high-speed trains travel very fast.
lines.chinese: 而且，那时我们花很多时间在路上。现在高铁行驶得很快。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: Cool!
lines.chinese: 真酷！

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: Mum, what was your life like in the past?
lines.chinese: 妈妈，你过去的生活是什么样的？

lines.speaker: Mum
lines.english: In the past, I worked in an office. These days, I sometimes work from home and have online meetings.
lines.chinese: 过去，我在办公室工作。如今，我有时在家工作，开线上会议。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: What about you, Dad?
lines.chinese: 爸爸，你呢？

lines.speaker: Dad
lines.english: Twenty years ago, I went to shops and paid in cash. Now I often shop online and pay on my smartphone.
lines.chinese: 二十年前，我去商店购物，用现金付款。现在，我经常网购，并用智能手机付款。

lines.speaker: Dad
lines.english: Oh no!
lines.chinese: 哦，不！

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: Don't worry, Dad. We have a robot helper.
lines.chinese: 别担心，爸爸。我们有一个机器人助手。
